plan.title: Withdraw live RFQ with two bids

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with two bids without creating or searching for another event.
Ensure the Withdraw Project action is available.
Ensure the RFQ project flow is enabled for the prepared event.
Withdraw the live project using the required withdrawal reason.
Assert that Procol records the project as withdrawn.
Open the RFQ activity drawer to inspect the withdrawal record.
Assert that the withdrawal reason appears in Order Activity.
Open the History tab where withdrawn events should appear.
Assert that the prepared event appears in the History list.
Open the buyer's Responses view to confirm the two bid responses remain visible after withdrawal.
Assert that both bid responses remain visible to the buyer.
Inspect the invited vendor's supplier-portal view after withdrawal.
Open the prepared event's overview in the vendor portal.
Assert that the vendor sees the event as withdrawn.
Open the pricing round to test whether the vendor can revise after withdrawal.
Assert that a vendor bid revision is refused after the event is withdrawn.
